requirements.title: Processor provides ISO_C_BINDING and its required public entities
requirements.definition: The processor shall provide ISO_C_BINDING and make accessible C_NULL_PTR, C_NULL_FUNPTR, Table 18.1 character constants (C_NULL_CHAR, C_ALERT, C_BACKSPACE, C_FORM_FEED, C_NEW_LINE, C_CARRIAGE_RETURN, C_HORIZONTAL_TAB, C_VERTICAL_TAB), Table 18.2 kind constants (C_SIGNED_CHAR, C_SHORT, C_INT, C_LONG, C_LONG_LONG, C_SIZE_T, C_INT8_T, C_INT16_T, C_INT32_T, C_INT64_T, C_INT_LEAST8_T, C_INT_LEAST16_T, C_INT_LEAST32_T, C_INT_LEAST64_T, C_INT_FAST8_T, C_INT_FAST16_T, C_INT_FAST32_T, C_INT_FAST64_T, C_INTMAX_T, C_INTPTR_T, C_PTRDIFF_T, C_FLOAT, C_DOUBLE, C_LONG_DOUBLE, C_FLOAT_COMPLEX, C_DOUBLE_COMPLEX, C_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX, C_BOOL, C_CHAR), C_PTR, C_FUNPTR, and the 18.2.3 procedures (C_ASSOCIATED, C_F_POINTER, C_F_PROCPOINTER, C_F_STRPOINTER, C_FUNLOC, C_LOC, C_SIZEOF, F_C_STRING).

pending.iso-c-binding-module-provided: Fortran-only plan: USE, INTRINSIC :: ISO_C_BINDING in a module and initialize a non-default integer sentinel after successful elaboration.
pending.required-null-constants-accessible: Fortran-only plan: import C_NULL_PTR and C_NULL_FUNPTR by ONLY list, assign them to TYPE(C_PTR) and TYPE(C_FUNPTR) variables initialized from nonnull controls, then verify C_ASSOCIATED reports .false. for each null value.
pending.required-kind-and-character-constants-ac: Fortran-only plan: import every Table 18.2 kind constant (C_SIGNED_CHAR, C_SHORT, C_INT, C_LONG, C_LONG_LONG, C_SIZE_T, C_INT8_T, C_INT16_T, C_INT32_T, C_INT64_T, C_INT_LEAST8_T, C_INT_LEAST16_T, C_INT_LEAST32_T, C_INT_LEAST64_T, C_INT_FAST8_T, C_INT_FAST16_T, C_INT_FAST32_T, C_INT_FAST64_T, C_INTMAX_T, C_INTPTR_T, C_PTRDIFF_T, C_FLOAT, C_DOUBLE, C_LONG_DOUBLE, C_FLOAT_COMPLEX, C_DOUBLE_COMPLEX, C_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX, C_BOOL, C_CHAR) and every Table 18.1 character constant (C_NULL_CHAR, C_ALERT, C_BACKSPACE, C_FORM_FEED, C_NEW_LINE, C_CARRIAGE_RETURN, C_HORIZONTAL_TAB, C_VERTICAL_TAB); assign each kind constant to a distinct default integer variable initialized to -999 and each character constant to a distinct length-one character variable initialized to "#".
pending.c-pointer-types-accessible: Fortran-only plan: import C_PTR and C_FUNPTR by ONLY list, declare one scalar variable of each type, initialize with C_NULL_PTR and C_NULL_FUNPTR, and verify the null association status through C_ASSOCIATED.
pending.iso-c-binding-procedures-accessible: Fortran-only plan: import the procedure names C_ASSOCIATED, C_F_POINTER, C_F_PROCPOINTER, C_F_STRPOINTER, C_FUNLOC, C_LOC, C_SIZEOF, and F_C_STRING by ONLY list. Executable semantic plans for C_ASSOCIATED and C_F_POINTER are in 18.2.3.2 and 18.2.3.3; C_F_PROCPOINTER, C_F_STRPOINTER, C_FUNLOC, C_LOC, C_SIZEOF, and F_C_STRING are deferred to 18.2.3.4 through 18.2.3.9 sibling catalogues.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first and assert only portable Clause 18 properties: ISO_C_BINDING accessibility, exact named-constant relations, exact logical results, pointer association status, shape and lower-bound results, values recovered through C_LOC/C_F_POINTER round trips, or mixed Fortran/C calls through declared interoperable interfaces. Processor-dependent kind values, pointer bit patterns, C address numeric values, companion-processor availability, storage alignment, and C library details are not asserted.

requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16, and 17 for source form, types, declarations, expressions, execution, modules, procedure interfaces, C_LOC/C_SIZEOF and intrinsic procedure foundations, and IEEE/reference support. Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: later Clause 18 interoperability conditions, ISO_C_BINDING procedures after 18.2.3.3, ISO_Fortran_binding.h descriptor semantics, and companion C processor details.

requirements.title: Processor may expose additional ISO_C_BINDING public entities
requirements.definition: A processor may provide public ISO_C_BINDING entities beyond those listed by the standard.

pending.additional-public-entities-processor-lat: No portable oracle may require either presence or absence of an unlisted public ISO_C_BINDING entity; future tests must use ONLY imports for standardized names.
